facts.fact: ACTPOL says Cameroon's Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 gave organisations 18 months to comply, a period that ended on 23 June 2026.
ACTPOL, citing the African Union status list of 2 February 2026, says Cameroon has signed the Malabo Convention without ratifying it.
ACTPOL says it found no decree creating Cameroon's Personal Data Protection Authority as of July 2026.
